integrity: Both bundled Python verifiers run with only the standard library. Independent external audit not performed. The 1992/1999 sources do not have a verified exact first-release day; 2012-02-23 is the day-verified submission date for the included arXiv source, not a claimed first-ever treatment.
scientific_limitations: Uses an established dense-sum-free structural theorem. Applies only to one-swap moves at one below maximum cardinality for odd n at least 15 or even n at least 20. No claim of novelty beyond best-knowledge publication comparison.
title: Two parity-dependent stabilization thresholds for near-extremal sum-free exchange graphs
